# HALF — software studio

> HALF is a small Czech software studio that builds digital products end-to-end:
> websites, web apps, mobile apps, APIs, desktop software, AI integrations and
> automation. Positioning: "The other half of your idea" — the client brings the
> idea, HALF designs, builds, ships and operates it. Direct contact with the
> people writing the code, no middle layers.

## Services

- Websites — presentational sites (Next.js/Astro, WebGL & motion design, SEO and GEO by default)
- Web apps — internal tools to SaaS products (React/Next.js, realtime, dashboards)
- Mobile apps — iOS & Android from one codebase (React Native/Expo)
- APIs & integrations — REST/GraphQL, payments, ERP, CRM
- Desktop apps — Windows, macOS, Linux (Electron/Tauri)
- AI integration — LLMs in business workflows (Claude/GPT, RAG, measurable output)
- Automation — workflows, scripting, reporting; hours saved weekly

## AI-ready websites

HALF builds websites prepared for AI search (GEO) and AI agents:
structured data (schema.org JSON-LD), server-rendered content readable without
JavaScript, llms.txt, open access for AI crawlers, copy written to be cited by
AI assistants, and optional machine-readable APIs or MCP endpoints.

## Selected work

- Je Postaveno (jepostaveno.cz) — Czech construction portal: articles and series,
  verified-company directory, advisory Q&A with an AI assistant.
- Izolace FUK (izolacefuk.cz) — marketing site for an insulation contractor:
  project gallery, lead-inquiry form, 4,000+ completed projects nationwide.

## Offer

Free clickable demo: HALF builds a clickable prototype with test data before any
contract — no invoice, no commitment.
